text:
He can. He is on his way to doing so. Eisenhower and Churchill both said that they would be invading Europe. And it was in their interest to make Hitler think it would be sooner rather than later. Nonetheless, they chose their moment. When there are wars going on, one dozen advertise precisely what one will do, if they give any clue at all.
Your master Putin has no cause for complaint. Putin signed a treaty in which he undertook to defend the borders of Ukraine as they were in 1999, not just respect them, defend them.
